_comment: Maybe Don't Gateway — Claude Code hook configuration.
Default: 'Both' pattern — hooks validate CLI tools (Bash), MCP gateway validates MCP tools.
This avoids double-validating MCP tool calls that already go through the gateway proxy.
For 'hooks only' pattern (no MCP gateway), add a second matcher entry for MCP tools:
Update /path/to/maybe-dont-hook.sh to the actual path of the exported hook script.
Set MAYBE_DONT_URL in your environment if the gateway is not at http://localhost:8080.
